column1: # Every crop a tracked farming patch can hold, mirroring RuneLite's Time Tracking plugin
# (Produce), Copyright (c) 2018 Abex and Copyright (c) 2018, NotFoxtrot, BSD 2-Clause
# License. A crop advances one growth stage per farming tick and finishes growing after
# (stages - 1) * tick minutes. Once harvestable, some keep producing: they hold the
# harvest stages' pickings and regrow one every regrow minutes; 0 means no regrow. The
# item is only the sidebar row's icon, with RuneLite's ItemID constant beside it.
# Tick rate 0: weeds regrow, but a weedy patch has no timer worth showing.
# Allotment crops: 10-minute grow ticks; single harvest of 3 lives, no regrow.
# Flower crops: 5-minute grow ticks; picked once, do not regrow.
# Bush crops: 20-minute grow and regrow ticks; regrow up to 5 berry pickings.
# Hop crops: single harvest of 3 lives, no regrow.
# Herbs: 80 minutes (4 ticks of 20); single harvest of 3 lives. Dead herbs share one
# varbit range, so ANYHERB stands for every species.
# Trees: 40-minute ticks; stage count varies by species; harvested once.
# Fruit trees: 160-minute grow ticks; regrow a fruit every 45 minutes.
# Cactus: spines and potatoes regrow after the first harvest.
# Special single-patch crops; regrow only where Time Tracking's table gives one.
# Compost bins: a closed bin converts over 40-minute ticks into collectable buckets (15,
# or 30 in the big Farming Guild bin). The empty-bin rows stand in for Time Tracking's
# EMPTY state and are never timed; they borrow the compost-bucket icon (6032) because Time
